implicit_default.purpose: preserve the pre-Candidate012 generated URDF without claiming an engine default value

candidate012_control_mu1p0.purpose: explicit configured control for the Candidate012 sensitivity study

candidate012_treatment_mu1p5.purpose: single-variable higher-friction treatment with all geometry and sequence inputs held fixed

claim_boundary: Coefficients are bounded simulation sensitivity parameters, not measured SO-101 or cube material properties.
The implicit profile deliberately does not assign or infer an SDFormat or DART default coefficient.
A generated URDF profile is accepted only after gz sdf conversion confirms both intended pad collision surfaces and no unintended target.
Explicit profiles leave the two pad collisions unnamed in URDF because the pinned Gazebo converter drops link-level mu tags on named collisions; paired control and treatment use the same workaround.
Sequence completion, contact samples, and transient lift remain insufficient for physics_grasp_verified without at least 20 mm lift and the configured retention window.
